name: Early twentieth century
description: You will come of age as electric light spreads, empires crack, and the old mage families insist the modern world will pass them by.

name: Postwar years
description: You will come of age in a world rebuilding after catastrophe, where old lineages are broke and new ones are hungry.

name: Late twentieth century
description: You will come of age among televisions, telephones and traffic, when hiding magic from ordinary people has never been harder.

name: New millennium
description: You will come of age as mobile phones and the internet spread further every year, and fewer and fewer secrets stay hidden.
